stem: Travelers whose passports, which must be shown to the gate agent together with the boarding pass, will not be ______ for at least six months after the date of entry may be refused boarding.
The inspector's report describes the cracked ramp at the loading dock, which has already damaged two pallet trucks this winter, as being in ______ need of repair.
The three-hour workshop on data privacy, which was announced only two days in advance, turned out to be so ______ attended that the organizers canceled the afternoon session.
The cable that runs across the main corridor to the new copier is a trip ______, so the safety officer has asked for it to be taped down or rerouted by Friday.
Several prospective tenants who toured the building last week have since ______, by telephone and by e-mail, whether pets will be permitted once the lease is signed in the fall.
Under the terms of the lease, the tenant must ______ the unit and hand all keys to the building manager by noon on the last day of the contract, even if repairs are still under way.

The ambiguous wording on the front of the brochure may ______ customers, particularly those who glance only at the large type, into believing that the discount applies to every product in the catalog.
Heavy machinery in the loading area should not be allowed to ______, as it did twice last month, with the recording sessions that take place in the studio next door.
The audit found that the subcontractor, whose invoices the company had been paying without checking them, had ______ the company by almost $12,000 for materials that were never delivered.
Since flexible hours were introduced in the spring, staff ______ at the call center has fallen from 31 percent to 14 percent, and the recruitment budget has been cut accordingly.
Before the prototype was shown at the trade fair, the engineers filed a ______ for the new valve design, so that competitors could not manufacture a valve that works in the same way.
Company procedure requires that the equipment be switched off and the area cleared before any maintenance work begins, so a lockout check must always ______ the first inspection of the machine.
Any appliance that stops working within twelve months because it was ______ when it left the factory will be replaced free of charge, provided that the original receipt is presented.
To comply with the fire code, the venue has limited the ______ of its second-floor banquet room to 180 guests, which forced the organizers to close registration for the dinner early.
